results.text: First, it requires the models to understand multilingual input texts, and generate multilin- gual target sequences. So both the encoder and the decoder should be pre-trained together. results.title: Cross-Lingual Natural Language Generation via Pre-Training
results.text: We propose to pretrain the encoder and the de- coder of a sequence-to-sequence model under both mono- lingual and cross-lingual settings. The pre-training objective encourages the model to represent different languages in the shared space, so that we can conduct zero-shot cross-lingual transfer. After the pre-training procedure, we use monolin- gual data to ﬁne-tune the pre-trained model on downstream NLG tasks.

results.title: Cross-Lingual Natural Language Generation via Pre-Training
results.text: 5 Conclusion In this paper, we propose a pre-training method for cross- lingual natural language generation (NLG) that can trans- fer monolingual NLG supervision signals to all pre-trained languages. With the pre-trained model, we achieve zero- shot cross-lingual NLG on several languages by only ﬁne- tuning once. Experimental results show that our model out- performs the machine-translation-based pipeline model on several cross-lingual NLG tasks.

results.text: However, such methods have to use multiple MT systems, which renders them suffer- ing from error propagation.
